set.body:
Problem:
BidsStudyCompiler resolves confounds even when recipe.confounds is None, so equally specific confound files can abort a recipe that explicitly requested no confounds. RequireDerivative also silently means one common run-agnostic derivative mask for multi-run units.

Scope:
- Gate confound discovery and ambiguity handling entirely behind recipe.confounds.
- Add the exact regression fixture: confounds=None plus two equally specific confound tables must compile with no confound reference.
- Preserve strict missing/ambiguous failures when confounds are requested.
- Make the common-mask contract explicit, preferably by renaming RequireDerivative to RequireCommonDerivative while the API is still new.
- Test Explicit, common derivative, and run-mask intersection policies.
- Exercise compiler AmbiguousCompanion, IncompatibleGeometry, and DuplicateRun branches with realistic catalog fixtures.

Acceptance:
- Unrequested confounds cannot add CatalogIssue values or prevent CandidateRun construction.
- Requested missing/ambiguous confounds produce the expected typed issue codes.
- A multi-run unit with one common mask succeeds; distinct run masks follow the declared common-mask/intersection policy without surprise.
- Explicit masks bypass derivative-mask lookup and retain the declared artifact identity.
- fmriWorkflowJVM/test and fmriWorkflowJS/test pass without JVM concerns leaking into shared tests.
set.title: Workflow ingest: fix optional confounds and define mask-policy semantics
